demo_banner: Demo data — not connected to a PC
welcome_unofficial: Unofficial companion app. Not affiliated with the GTBike V authors, Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
connect_not_available: Connecting to a real PC arrives in a later version of this app. Explore it with demo data for now.
power_zone_demo_ftp: Zones use a demo FTP of %1$d W
reason_adapter_absent: The game adapter is not running on the PC.
reason_adapter_stale: The PC has not sent new data recently.
reason_unsupported_version: This GTBike V version is not supported yet.
reason_mod_transition: GTBike V is starting or stopping. Wait a moment.
reason_game_not_in_control: The game is paused or loading.
connect_intro: Start the Android bridge on your PC (node bridge/start-v1.mjs), then press Enter in its window for a six-digit pairing code.
connect_scan_hint: Scan the QR shown by the bridge on this PC, or enter the six-digit pairing code below.
connect_verify_body: Compare this identity with the one printed by the bridge on your PC. Continue only if they match.
connect_http_dev_warning: Development connection without encryption (debug builds only). Use it only on your home network.
pair_again_body: The PC no longer accepts this phone. Scan the QR in the bridge window on the PC to pair again.
pair_expired_body: For security, pairing with the PC lasts 30 days. Scan the QR in the bridge window on the PC to keep using it. If you do not see the QR, press Enter in that window.
op_waiting: Sent. Waiting for the game to confirm…
op_applied: Done. The game confirmed the change.
op_uncertain: No confirmation. Check the game before trying again.
routes_flag_not_supported: This route does not support it.
routes_pc_selector_closed: The route selector is closed on the PC.
routes_pc_showing_this: The PC selector shows this route.
routes_pc_showing_other: The PC selector shows another route.
routes_confirm_apply_body: The game may move your rider to the start, save the current activity, reset totals, add route bots and turn on autopilot. Stop before applying.
routes_confirm_free_ride_body: Clears the current route. Your ride continues without following a course; nothing is saved or turned off.
routes_confirm_workout_body: “%1$s” is running on the PC. Applying “%2$s” works as in the mod menu: the current activity is saved (if over 100 m), the route loads and the workout starts again from its countdown, with the trainer in ERG. What you did of the workout is not marked as finished.
routes_confirm_free_ride_workout: “%1$s” keeps running without restarting, but the route riders go away, including the workout's reference rider.
pc_settings_intro: Values read from GTBike V on your PC. Changes apply to the game and are shown again once the PC confirms them.
reason_mod_inactive: Activate GTBike V on the PC first.
reason_mod_not_loaded: GTBike V is not loaded in the game.
reason_workout_pc_control: A workout is running on the PC. Manage it on the PC.
reason_panel_closed: Open the route selector on the PC first.
reason_autopilot_on: Not available while autopilot is on.
reason_revision_conflict: Something changed on the PC. Review the current values and try again.
reason_instance_changed: The game adapter restarted. Review the current state and try again.
reason_bridge_busy: The PC is handling another request. Try again in a moment.
reason_operation_unknown: No confirmation. Check the game before trying again.
reason_pc_unreachable: The PC cannot be reached. Check the address and that both devices share the network.
reason_auth_required: This phone is not paired with the PC.
reason_pin_expired: The pairing code expired. Use the new code shown on the PC.
reason_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
reason_address_invalid: Enter the PC IPv4 address (for example 192.168.1.20) and a port from 1024 to 65535.
reason_qr_invalid: That QR code is not from the GTAV Riding Companion bridge. Scan the one in the bridge window on the PC.
reason_qr_used: This QR was already used. Press Enter in the bridge window on the PC to show a new one, then scan it.
reason_qr_scan_unavailable: The QR scanner is not available on this phone. Type the address and port instead.
reason_bridge_changed: A different bridge answered at that address. Check the identity again.
reason_tls_required: This app version needs an encrypted connection to the PC.
reason_tls_not_supported: This bridge uses a connection this app version does not support yet.
reason_invalid_response: The PC sent an unexpected answer.
reason_not_found: Not found on the PC. Refresh the list.
devices_intro: Sensors are found and connected by GTBike V on your PC. Here you choose which source the PC uses for each function.
training_read_only: Browse, start and follow workouts. Pausing, skipping and ending stay on the PC.
training_select_confirm_body: The PC starts it as the Select button in GTBike V does and puts your trainer in ERG: the resistance will follow the workout's target power, calculated with your FTP. Pause, skip or end it on the PC.
training_select_replace_body: “%1$s” is running on the PC and will end: it stops and is replaced by “%2$s”, as if you chose it in the mod menu. It is not saved as finished; what you have done stays in the current activity. The trainer stays in ERG with the new workout's power, starting from its countdown.
training_reference_ftp: Reference watts as the PC computed them with FTP %1$d W.
training_pc_controls: Pause, skip or end this workout on the PC.
training_loading_pc: The PC is still loading its workouts.
activities_empty: No saved activities on the PC yet.
activities_folder_unknown: The PC has not reported its Activities folder yet. Start GTA V with the adapter once.
activity_save_hint: Stop first. GTBike V saves rides longer than 100 m and then starts a new activity.
activity_save_body: GTBike V writes the FIT file, resets totals and starts a new activity. The PC then shows its own summary: choosing Discard there deletes the file.
activity_save_uncertain: Check the Activities list before saving again.
activity_source_fit: Values read from the FIT file. Missing values stay empty.
activity_power_chart_description: Power over time, up to %1$d W. Breaks are gaps in the recording.
activity_no_power: This file has no power data.
reason_device_changed: The PC switched to another device. Review it and try again.
reason_save_too_short: Nothing to save yet: ride more than 100 m first.
reason_fit_invalid: The FIT file is incomplete or damaged.
map_description: Game map with your position and the route.
map_outside: Your position is outside this map image.
map_image_unavailable: The PC map image could not be loaded.
riders_disabled_on_pc: The PC bridge does not share the ranking. Start it with --enable-riders.
riders_join_on_pc: To join it, use the multiplayer option in the GTBike V menu on the PC.
diagnostics_intro: Versions and the state of each layer, useful when something does not work.
diagnostics_privacy: The copied text has no code, token, PC address, sensor IDs or rider names. Nothing is sent automatically.
reason_asset_unavailable: The PC does not offer this image.
phone_scan_intro: The phone only listens for nearby Bluetooth sensors and never connects to them. Choose one and GTBike V on your PC connects to it directly, so riding data does not pass through the phone.
phone_scan_no_bluetooth: This phone has no Bluetooth Low Energy.
phone_scan_bluetooth_off: Turn on the phone's Bluetooth to search.
phone_scan_location_off: On this Android version, location must be on to search for Bluetooth sensors. The app does not read your location.
phone_scan_scanning: Searching for 30 seconds… pedal or wear the sensors to wake them.
phone_scan_failed: Android could not start the search. Wait a moment and try again.
phone_scan_empty: No sensor that GTBike V can use was found. Wake the sensors and search again; ANT+ sensors do not appear here.
phone_scan_will_use_for: The PC will use it for
phone_scan_managed_on_pc: ANT+ sensors are managed in GTBike V on the PC.
phone_scan_no_function: GTBike V does not use this kind of sensor for the current sport.
phone_scan_waiting: Saved; waiting for the PC to connect
phone_scan_other_device: Saved; the PC still uses another sensor
reason_tls_fingerprint: Enter the 64 hexadecimal characters shown on the PC.
reason_tls_verification: Could not verify the PC certificate. Check the address and key fingerprint on the PC.
options_intro: GTBike V settings from its configuration file on the PC (gtbikev.com → Configuration). GTBike V rewrites that file while GTA V runs, so these change only with the game closed and apply the next time it starts. Weight, FTP, difficulty, Road Feel, bike and character change live in Profile and ride.
options_game_running: GTA V is running on the PC. Close the game to change these options (GTBike V would overwrite them). They apply the next time it starts.
options_game_closed: GTA V is closed: you can change these options. They apply the next time you start the game. A backup is kept on the PC.
options_unsaved: Unsaved changes. Tap Save; they apply the next time you start GTA V.
options_file_missing: GTBike V's configuration file was not found on the PC. Start GTA V with GTBike V once so it creates it.
options_bridge_too_old: The PC app is older than this phone app. Update GTAV Riding Companion on the PC to change game options.
options_conflict: The file changed on the PC since it was loaded. Tap Discard to reload it, then make your changes again.
options_saved_one: %1$d option saved. It applies the next time you start GTA V.
options_saved_other: %1$d options saved. They apply the next time you start GTA V.
options_traffic_hint: 100% shows no cars; 0% leaves the traffic as GTA V makes it.
options_bots_hint: Riders that join you on a route, up to 5. Set them all to 0 for no bots.
options_defensive_hint: Defensive: anyone aggressive close by dies. Aggressive: anyone too close who is not on a bike dies or their vehicle explodes.
options_fine_steering_hint: For the A and D steering keys on the PC. 1 steers fully.
options_waypoint_hint: Size 0 hides them. A route's own settings take precedence.
options_screenshot_hint: Use the offset with several monitors when GTA V is not on the main one: the main screen's width, or negative if the game screen is to its left.
options_menu_auto_open: Open the mod menu when you stop
options_show_clock: Show a clock when the menu is hidden
options_log_hint: 3 is the default (Info). For crash reports use 4 or 5 and send GTBike V's log files.
options_gps_hint: Real-world point that matches the centre of the GTA map in your FIT files. The default is a small island in the Pacific.
options_telemetry: Send anonymous usage data to GTBike V
options_multiplayer: Connect to the GTBike V multiplayer server
options_multiplayer_hint: Turning multiplayer back on uses the official GTBike V server.
reason_game_running: Close GTA V on the PC first.
help_connection_status_body: Your phone connects to the PC bridge. The game adapter, sensor receivers and individual sensors have separate states. A connected PC does not mean every sensor is ready.
help_connection_address_body: Enter the address and port shown by the bridge on your PC. Both devices must be on a network that lets them reach each other. The PC may use Ethernet. A guest Wi-Fi network may block the connection.
help_connection_pairing_body: Enter the current code displayed on the PC after verifying its identity. The code links this phone to that bridge. Request a new code on the PC if it expires.
help_connection_identity_body: Compare the bridge identity shown on your PC with the one on this phone. Do not accept an unexpected identity change. A familiar IP address alone does not identify the PC.
help_connection_lan_permission_body: Allow access so the app can reach the PC on your local network. If access is denied, connection controls remain unavailable. You can keep reading help and change this permission in Android settings.
help_connection_stale_body: The last game update is too old to use safely. Values may remain visible with their age, but controls are unavailable until fresh data arrives. This does not stop the ride on the PC.
help_connection_compatibility_body: Controls are available only when the bridge can verify them for the installed mod version. A version change may require an adapter update on the PC. Unavailable options explain their current limits.
help_mod_activate_body: Starts the mod's sensor connection flow. Readiness can take a moment and depends on the PC receivers and devices. The app shows the observed state after the request.
help_mod_deactivate_body: Stops the mod's receivers and multiplayer connection. The mod also attempts to save the current activity. This is different from saving an activity while keeping the mod active; check the resulting FIT file.
help_routes_browse_body: Previous and Next change the route you are previewing. Browsing does not start that route. The active route remains shown separately until you apply a selection.
help_routes_pc_preview_body: Opens or updates the route selector in the game when supported. Other changes made on the PC can replace this preview. Previewing does not apply the route.
help_routes_apply_body: Loads the chosen route in GTBike V. The game may move your rider, save the previous activity, reset totals, create route bots and turn on autopilot. Stop before applying. With a workout in progress, the app warns you first: as in the mod menu, that workout starts again from its countdown on the new route.
help_routes_loop_body: Repeats the route after a lap when the route supports looping. This option appears only for compatible routes. It is applied with the route selection.
help_routes_reverse_body: Uses the opposite direction for a compatible route. GTBike V's selector exposes this option for loop routes. It is applied with the route selection and may reset when another route is previewed.
help_routes_free_ride_body: Clears the selected course so you can ride without following that course. It is a route selection change, not an instruction to pause, save or turn off the mod.
help_routes_profile_body: Shows the elevation profile and map supplied or generated for the route. Distance and elevation may update as route data finishes loading. Missing images do not mean the route has no hills.
help_ride_autopilot_body: Lets GTBike V steer along its current route or destination while your sensor data controls movement. Applying a course can turn it on automatically. Availability depends on the current game state.
help_ride_obstacles_body: Changes the mod's obstacle-avoidance behaviour. The native menu disables this option while autopilot is on. It is a game assistance setting, not a guarantee that collisions cannot happen.
help_profile_weight_body: Your weight is used by the mod's riding simulation. Enter 40–150 kg, or the equivalent displayed unit. Existing activity calculations may retain the profile captured when that activity began.
help_profile_ftp_body: Functional Threshold Power is a rider profile reference used for training zones and statistics. Enter 50–500 W. Changing it does not request a fixed power from the trainer. An existing activity may retain its starting reference.
help_profile_hr_max_body: Used as a reference for the mod's heart-rate zones. Enter 50–220 bpm. This is a profile value; changing it does not change or calibrate the heart-rate sensor.
help_appearance_bike_body: Chooses one of the bicycles available in this mod installation. Applying it changes the in-game bicycle, not just the name in a settings file. Stop before changing it.
help_appearance_character_body: Changes the player model to an option provided by the mod. The available list comes from the PC. Apply while stopped and when the game allows player changes.
help_ride_difficulty_body: Scales uphill simulation sent to a compatible trainer. Lower percentages make uphill resistance changes smaller. This is not an overall fitness level or a power target. Disabled is a separate mod setting, not the same as 0%.
help_ride_road_feel_body: Enables surface feedback when the PC's connected trainer supports it. The mod applies it only in supported riding modes and conditions. Saving the setting does not prove that the hardware can produce the feedback.
help_ride_gearing_body: Chooses a gearing mode supported by the mod and connected hardware. Native mode requires compatible hardware. This companion does not send workout power adjustments; gear-key shortcuts during a workout are unavailable.
help_devices_policy_body: These are devices used by GTBike V on the PC, grouped by function. A device may serve more than one function. Your phone does not need to connect to those sensors over Bluetooth.
help_devices_auto_body: Clears the fixed source and exclusions for this function so GTBike V can choose an eligible source again. It can change which device supplies this reading.
help_devices_lock_body: Keeps the currently identified device as the selected source for this function. If it disappears, the reading may be unavailable instead of switching automatically. Choose Auto to clear the fixed policy.
help_devices_skip_body: Excludes the current source for this function and lets the PC seek another eligible source. It does not guarantee that another device is available. A locked source must be returned to Auto before this action is available.
help_devices_technology_body: The label shows how the PC receives this sensor's data. Receiver readiness and sensor presence are different. Use the PC's compatible receiver and the mod's device configuration to troubleshoot.
help_devices_missing_body: No valid reading is available for this function. Check that the sensor is awake and the PC receiver is ready. The app shows a dash for missing data; zero is reserved for a valid zero reading.
help_devices_phone_scan_body: The phone only listens to Bluetooth sensor announcements; it never connects to them, so the sensor stays free for the PC. When you choose one, GTBike V on the PC locks that sensor for the function and connects to it directly, so riding data does not pass through the phone. The PC must also be within Bluetooth range. ANT+ sensors cannot be found this way.
help_devices_phone_permission_body: Needed only to list Bluetooth sensors around you. On Android 12 and later the app declares that it does not use it to find your location. Android 11 and earlier require the location permission for any Bluetooth search. The rest of the app works without it.
help_devices_phone_disconnect_body: GTBike V on the PC closes its Bluetooth link to this sensor and stops using it. Functions pinned to it go back to Auto. Until you connect a sensor of that kind again from this screen, or deactivate and reactivate GTBike V, the PC does not reconnect to any sensor of that kind. Riding data never goes through the phone.
help_devices_phone_waiting_body: The PC already saved the sensor for this function but has not connected yet. Wake the sensor (pedal, or wear and moisten a chest strap) and keep it near the PC. If the PC still uses another sensor of the same kind, turn that one off.
help_training_catalog_body: Browse plans and workout details available on the PC. Open a workout to see its segments and reference power; you can start it from there.
help_training_select_body: Starts this workout on the PC exactly as its Select button in GTBike V does. The mod then puts the trainer in ERG: the resistance follows the workout's power targets (calculated with your FTP). If another workout is running on the PC, the app warns you first: it ends and is replaced, as when you choose a workout in the mod menu (it is not saved as finished; the activity goes on). Pausing, skipping and ending a workout stay on the PC.
help_training_progress_body: Shows the workout and interval currently running on the PC. Intervals can use time or distance. This screen observes progress and does not pause, skip, end or change the workout.
help_training_reference_body: Watts and cadence shown in the workout describe its reference values. They are information from the PC, not editable trainer commands. Your measured power and cadence appear separately.
help_activity_save_body: Asks the mod to save the current activity and start fresh activity totals while keeping the mod active. Stop first. GTBike V saves only after more than 100 m. This action is unavailable during an unfinished PC workout, and success is confirmed only after the FIT is available.
help_activity_save_unknown_body: The connection ended before the result was known. The activity may already have been saved. Refresh the PC state and activity list before sending another save request.
help_metrics_power_body: Shows the power reported by GTBike V in watts. A missing reading is different from a valid zero. The displayed value is measured data, not a power setting.
help_metrics_cadence_body: Shows the pedalling rate reported by the PC, in revolutions per minute. A missing source is shown as a dash. Workout reference cadence is displayed separately from your measured cadence.
help_metrics_heart_rate_body: Shows the valid pulse reading received by GTBike V from the PC's selected sensor. A connected receiver alone does not guarantee a pulse reading. Check the Heart rate device role if no value is available.
help_metrics_speed_body: GTBike V can use sensor speed or a virtual speed calculated by the mod. The source is shown when known. This is your in-game riding speed, not your phone's physical speed.
help_metrics_time_body: Counts time since the mod's current ride counters started or reset. It is different from moving time. Saving an activity or changing a route can reset these counters.
help_metrics_moving_time_body: Counts time that the activity records as moving. It may be shorter than ride time. This value comes from the current activity when available.
help_metrics_elevation_body: Ascent is the accumulated climbing in the activity. Gradient describes the current slope. They are different measurements and may have different availability.
help_activity_history_body: Lists completed FIT files from the PC's Activities folder. Route reference FIT files are not your activity history. The PC must be reachable to fetch files that have not been downloaded.
help_activity_download_body: Copies the selected completed activity to your phone so you can save or share it. It does not delete the PC file or finish the current ride.
help_activity_summary_body: The summary shows values available from the saved activity or a verified PC summary. Older FIT files may lack some values. Missing statistics are left unavailable rather than estimated from your current profile.
help_activity_power_chart_body: Shows valid power records from this activity. Gaps mean data is missing. A chart based on FIT records can use different averaging from the mod's summary; the source is identified.
help_activity_zones_body: Zones depend on the profile reference used for that activity. Historical zones are shown only when the required reference or verified summary is available. Changing today's FTP does not rewrite old activity data.
help_map_game_world_body: Shows the GTA world and available in-game rider position. It does not track your phone's location. If the map or its calibration is unavailable, use the dashboard and route details instead.
help_multiplayer_riders_body: Shows riders and bots known to the PC's multiplayer session. Availability depends on that session and server. This connection is separate from your phone's link to the PC.
help_multiplayer_join_body: Asks the mod to join the route with the most connected riders. You must first leave your current route. This does not select a specific rider or send an invitation.
help_advanced_bots_body: Controls supported bot definitions used when the mod creates a route group. These bots are different from ambient traffic cyclists. A saved change may apply only when the next group is created.
help_mod_config_options_body: GTBike V settings from its configuration file (traffic, route bots, cheering crowds, waypoints, screenshots, menu, clock, debug, GPS origin, telemetry, multiplayer). GTBike V rewrites that file while it runs, so they can be changed only with GTA V closed; they apply the next time the game starts. A backup is kept before each change.
help_advanced_traffic_body: Configures the mod's replacement of some traffic vehicles with bicycles and its supported behaviour presets. It is not a general traffic-density control. Some changes require the game script to reload.
help_settings_apply_mode_body: Saved means the value is stored. Active means its effect has been confirmed for the current game state. Some settings apply to the next activity or route, or after a script reload; the option shows which one.
help_app_language_body: The app uses your phone's language when it is English or Spanish, and English otherwise. You can choose English or Spanish for this app. This does not change GTA V's language or translate route names supplied by their authors.
help_app_theme_body: Choose a light theme, a dark theme or the phone's system theme. This changes only the companion's appearance and does not change graphics or brightness in GTA V.
help_app_units_body: Chooses the units used on this phone. The app converts values for display and sends settings in the units required by the bridge. It does not change GTA V's own measurement setting.
help_app_keep_awake_body: Keeps the display awake while the ride screen is visible. It stops applying when you leave the screen or put the app in the background.
help_app_unpair_body: Revokes this phone's access to the PC bridge and removes its saved credentials. It does not deactivate GTBike V or stop the ride on the PC.
help_diagnostics_local_body: Shows which part of the connection needs attention and the installed versions. Copying a diagnostic report omits access tokens and unnecessary personal data. It does not send logs to anyone.
pwa_pin_hint: Six digits. Press Enter in the bridge window on the PC to show a new code.
pwa_bridge_key_unavailable: Start the PC bridge and reload this page to connect.
pwa_qr_port_mismatch: The QR belongs to a different bridge port. Restart the PWA server with --bridge-port followed by the port shown in the QR.
